status: DEVELOPMENT-USED: this set informed the shipped abstention design and threshold; it is not held-out and cannot validate the design
provenance: author-built measurement on the shipped corpus (pariza/bbc-news-summary, 2225 articles); AI-assisted analysis, not an independent human benchmark
finding: MiniLM dense cosine scores do NOT separate nonsense from relevant out-of-vocabulary queries on this corpus; no fixed threshold or top-vs-runner-up margin abstains reliably. Scores are uncalibrated similarities, not probabilities.
overlap: nonsense tops reach 0.368 while relevant OOV dips to 0.276; ranges overlap
decision: abstain deterministically on empty/whitespace/stopword-only queries; tfidf mode stays conservative no-hit for OOV; hybrid OOV dense candidates are flagged low_confidence/exploratory in output; DENSE_MIN_SIM=0.20 is a development-selected near-zero-signal guard applied to the RAW dense similarity, NOT a validated relevance guard and NOT reliable no-hit detection; returned OOV scores are scaled by (1-HYBRID_ALPHA) for weighting consistency with the hybrid arm (raw_dense_score field preserves the raw value)
false_abstention_note: at 0.20: false-answer 'zucchini tornado wallpaper' (0.368) admitted; at 0.35: false-abstains 'hiking' (0.276) and still admits zucchini (0.368). No floor avoids both.
